newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Powerco seeks approval for plan to buy Egmont.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Powerco seeks approval for plan to buy Egmont.

text.p: Unlisted New Zealand electricity company Powerco Ltd has sought approval to purchase all the shares or assets of neighbouring, municipally-owned Egmont Electricity, the Commerce Commission said on Monday.
The Commission, which assess the competition aspects of mergers and takeovers in New Zealand, said it expected to release its final decision by July 21.

New Zealand's Commerce Act prohibits acquisitions that result in dominance being acquired or strengthened in any markets, but exemptions can be granted if the commission is satisfied that public benefits outweigh detriments to

Powerco said at the weekend it planned to buy Egmont for NZ$124 million from its South Taranaki District Council owners and noted that the contiguous nature of their customer coverage would allow significant savings from the operation of a combined company.
